statement: Claude Code's official hook contract exposes lifecycle events including pre- and post-tool use, permission requests, session start/end, and stop; PreToolUse hooks can deny a call before normal permission-mode checks, while allow decisions cannot override stricter deny rules.

display_text.zh-CN: Claude Code 官方 hook contract 暴露 pre/post tool use、permission request、session start/end 与 stop 等事件；PreToolUse hook 可在常规 permission-mode 检查前拒绝调用，而 allow 决策不能越过更严格的 deny rules。
display_text.en: Claude Code's official hook contract exposes lifecycle events including pre- and post-tool use, permission requests, session start/end, and stop; PreToolUse hooks can deny a call before normal permission-mode checks, while allow decisions cannot override stricter deny rules.

evidence.title: Claude Code — Automate actions with hooks
evidence.locator: PreToolUse; Hook events; Hooks and permission modes

notes: Hook ordering and behavior were not reproduced locally; only the documented interface is asserted.
